remarks: Unique Opportunity to Own Office Space This modern, contemporary office property offers a unique opportunity for an owner-user, small business, or investor seeking an income-producing commercial property. Completely remodeled from the ground up in 2006, the property features: 8 separate offices, 3 bathrooms, 5 on-site parking spaces, and a flexible duplex layout with 3 separate entrances. The building is situated on a single-level corner lot and features modern finishes throughout.
